entries.title: Deus Ex
entries.definitive_edition: Deus Ex Game of the Year Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the GOG/Steam PC release with renderer/community-fix guidance.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Classic PC route with modern renderer and faithful mod support.

primary.version: Game of the Year Edition on GOG/Steam
primary.why: The Windows PC Game of the Year Edition is the best route because it contains the patched classic release, modern storefront access, and the highest-flexibility route for community compatibility fixes, renderers, and faithful visual mods. The PS2 port rearranges and streamlines levels, so it is not the completeness target.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Deus Ex GOTY on GOG or Steam, then look into renderer, resolution, and community-fix guidance before capture. Treat the delayed official remaster as a future revisit, not the current primary.

entries.remaster_caveats: An official remaster was announced and then delayed with preorders refunded; it is not a current play recommendation until it actually ships and can be compared.

entries.title: Deus Ex: Invisible War
entries.definitive_edition: Deus Ex: Invisible War on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with compatibility guidance; no console emulation route is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with modern compatibility fixes.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best route because it is the complete game with current GOG/Steam access and PC community-fix options. The Xbox version has no sourced exclusive content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Deus Ex 2: Invisible War on GOG or Steam and check for modern resolution and stability fixes before capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or expanded edition is documented.

entries.title: Deus Ex: Human Revolution
entries.definitive_edition: Deus Ex: Human Revolution - Director's Cut on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the Director's Cut PC build; no console emulation route is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC Director's Cut is the best route because it includes The Missing Link and other DLC, improves boss encounters, adds developer commentary/new-game-plus features, and keeps PC capture/settings flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Deus Ex: Human Revolution - Director's Cut on Steam or GOG and play that version instead of the original 2011 release.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use Director's Cut rather than the original release for the integrated DLC and boss-fight changes.

entries.title: Deus Ex: The Fall
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release if already owned

emulation.emulator: Native Windows PC or native mobile
emulation.notes: Use PC if owned; otherwise use a current official mobile listing only.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC port presentation with mobile-origin limitations.

primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best archival play target because it is the highest-capture route for the mobile spin-off, although the game was designed first for iOS and the PC port has known quality caveats.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam Windows PC version if it is already in your library; if not, use the currently available mobile route rather than unsourced downloads.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or complete edition is documented; availability should be checked before planning a stream.

entries.title: Deus Ex: Mankind Divided
entries.definitive_edition: Deus Ex: Mankind Divided Digital Deluxe Edition plus Season Pass on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the PC Digital Deluxe or base game plus Season Pass route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Dawn Engine PC presentation with complete story DLC.

primary.version: Digital Deluxe Edition plus Season Pass
primary.why: The Windows PC Digital Deluxe/Season Pass route is the best version because it covers the base game and story DLC on the highest-flexibility platform. The Season Pass includes the narrative DLCs System Rift and A Criminal Past, while Desperate Measures is available as a free story mission.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Deus Ex: Mankind Divided Digital Deluxe Edition or the base game plus Season Pass on Steam/GOG. Play the base campaign, then the Jensen's Stories DLC missions.

entries.remaster_caveats: Breach and the VR Experience also exist as standalone spin-offs and are listed separately.

entries.title: Deus Ex GO

emulation.notes: Use the current official mobile release rather than old Windows copies.

primary.why: The current iOS/Android release is the best route because Deus Ex GO was designed as a mobile puzzle game and was made available again under DECA after the earlier shutdown. The old Microsoft/Windows route is not the current reliable recommendation.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Deus Ex GO from the App Store or Google Play under the current DECA listing and play on a supported mobile device.

entries.remaster_caveats: The game was previously removed from stores and shut down, then later made available again on iOS/Android; check storefront availability before planning.

entries.title: Deus Ex: Breach
entries.definitive_edition: Deus Ex: Breach free standalone on Steam

primary.why: The free standalone Steam release is the best route because it exposes the Mankind Divided Breach mode as its own PC game, with no need to launch the full Mankind Divided campaign.
primary.how_to_play: Install Deus Ex: Breach for free on Steam and play the standalone Windows PC version after or alongside Mankind Divided.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a standalone mode/spin-off rather than a story campaign.

entries.title: Deus Ex: Mankind Divided - VR Experience

emulation.notes: Requires a compatible VR headset; no flat-screen route is documented.

primary.why: The free Windows PC VR Experience is the only release route: it lets players tour four Mankind Divided environments in VR and requires a VR headset rather than being a full campaign.
primary.how_to_play: Install the free Steam VR Experience on Windows PC and use a supported VR headset such as Vive/Rift-class hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a VR environment tour rather than a full Deus Ex campaign.
